description: Native Pet, founded in 2017 in St. Louis, Missouri by Dan Schaefer and Pat Barron, makes organic, limited-ingredient, vet-formulated supplements for dogs and cats — probiotics, hip and joint chews, pumpkin powder, omega oil, calming chews and The Daily — sold DTC and in 2,200+ Tractor Supply stores nationwide.

evidence.summary: Native Pet's own affiliate-program page (opened directly) is a live Superfiliate portal application: it asks for the pet's name, email and PayPal email, a chosen discount code, Instagram (required), TikTok and YouTube, pet age and allergies, and address — a creator-first application collecting social handles and paying via PayPal. The brand's affiliate one-pager likewise links this page as its affiliate signup.

Native Pet's own affiliate one-pager says 'Please reach out to partners@nativepet.com', links the affiliate programme page https://nativepet.com/pages/affiliate-program, and lists its socials: Facebook facebook.com/nativepet, Instagram instagram.com/thenativepet/, Pinterest thenativepet.

Lasso lists Native Pet at up to 15% commission, 14-day cookie, $10 payout threshold; Acciyo's roundup independently lists 15%. RATE CONFLICT: FlawlessMLM reports 20% on first orders via Impact with a 30-day cookie and minimal repeat-order commission — recorded rate is 15% (two sources) with the 20% first-order Impact claim noted here. No cap statement was found on any fetched page.

Beacons Universe (updated 19 Nov 2026) counts 421 creators who have posted about Native Pet all-time, 50 in the last 30 days (104 mentions), and 39 sponsored posts in the last 12 months — direct evidence of HIGH creator saturation, so creator_saturation is 'high'.

Native Pet's Affiliate Coordinator job post describes its DTC affiliate programme as focused on creators on Instagram, YouTube and TikTok, run day-to-day on Superfiliate (with GRIN), constantly sourcing and onboarding new affiliates, with an affiliate email inbox and a Discord ambassador community — a staffed, actively recruiting creator programme.

name: Native Pet

reasons.compensation: 15% published by two listings; a conflicting 20% first-order Impact claim is noted, and no cap statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: Published partnerships email partners@nativepet.com on the brand's own affiliate one-pager, plus a live official application portal and a Google Form route.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2017 in St. Louis, $17M raised (Series B $11M), full line in 2,200+ Tractor Supply stores.
reasons.niche_fit: Vet-formulated dog and cat supplements for gut, joint, calm and coat — everyday-routine pet UGC.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications open now on the brand's own site, with the brand actively hiring to source and onboard new affiliates.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 421 Beacons creators, 39 sponsored posts in 12 months, a staffed programme on Superfiliate/GRIN with a Discord ambassador community, and an application built around Instagram/TikTok/YouTube handles.

description: Ollie (Ollie Pets Inc.), founded in 2016 in New York City, is a direct-to-consumer subscription brand selling fresh and baked human-grade dog food — personalised meal plans formulated with veterinary nutritionists and tailored to a dog's breed, age, weight and activity — plus treats and supplements, donating a portion of proceeds to rescue shelters; it was acquired by Agrolimen in February 2026 and continues to operate independently.

evidence.summary: Creator Hero's in-depth review states Ollie affiliates earn a flat $60 commission per sale with a 30-day cookie via Impact Radius, joining via Ollie's own affiliate page https://www.myollie.com/affiliate/ which routes to Impact; FlexOffers is listed at $48 per sale. Because the pay is a flat fee, not a percentage, commission_rate is null. RATE CONFLICT: one March 2026 roundup (affiliatemarketinggirl.io) claims 20% on first orders in-house — not corroborated by any other fetched source; the $60 flat figure is corroborated by Lasso, LinkWhisper, FunnelScene, Post Affiliate Pro and UpPromote.

UpPromote's Ollie directory entry confirms the program is hosted on Impact Radius, pays up to $60 flat per new-customer sale, 30-day cookie, US only, accepts pet blogs, social media, email and review sites, and explicitly rates TikTokers and pet content creators as highly suitable.

Beacons Universe (updated 18 Nov 2026) counts 143 creators who have posted about Ollie Pets all-time, 9 in the last 30 days, with 19 sponsored posts in the last 12 months — an active creator programme, but far too many creators to evidence 'low' saturation, so saturation is unknown.

Petfood Industry reports Agrolimen acquired New York City-based Ollie (founded 2016, veterinary-backed fresh dog food with personalised plans) in February 2026, with Ollie continuing as an independent brand; Ollie's own PR directs followers to Instagram @ollie and www.myollie.com.

name: Ollie

opportunity.title: Ollie Affiliate Program (Impact) — $60 flat per new customer

reasons.compensation: Flat $60 per new-customer sale via Impact (30-day cookie) — the highest per-conversion payout in this group; one uncorroborated 20% claim is noted as a conflict, and no cap statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: A brand-owned affiliate landing page routing to Impact, but no published partnerships email on fetched pages.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2016, pioneer of fresh dog food, acquired by Agrolimen in 2026 reportedly for $600M+ while operating independently.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium fresh dog food built for feeding-time, unboxing and health-transformation pet content — core pets UGC.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to apply today via myollie.com/affiliate → Impact, US affiliates.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 143 Beacons creators, 19 sponsored posts in 12 months, and Ollie runs creator videos as its own ads — documented, active creator use.

description: Non-toxic cleaning brand founded in Texas by Allison Evans, Kelly Love and Marilee Nelson, built around a plant- and mineral-based Concentrate that dilutes into all-purpose, bathroom, laundry and other household cleaners under a 'Toss the Toxins' healthy-home mission; products are human-safe, free of harmful preservatives, EWG Verified / MADE SAFE certified, sold direct-to-consumer and increasingly in retail including Target, with reported revenue of $40 million in 2023.

evidence.summary: Branch Basics' own Awin merchant profile states verbatim: 'we are offering a 10% commission on sales with a 30 day cookie window', with an AOV around $60, and says the brand wants 'to help publishers large and small monetize all their wonderful content'.

PRPackage's ambassador directory (verified 26 Sep 2026 against branchbasics.com) lists a separate Branch Basics Ambassador Program running on Superfiliate: a 15% audience discount code at Ambassador level, then tiered commission of 5% / 10% / 15% / 20% at Bronze and higher tiers; applicants must be existing Branch Basics users in the US or Canada with 1,000+ followers and share at least one story set per month. NOTE: this tiered ambassador structure (up to 20%) sits alongside the flat 10% Awin rate — the two routes pay differently, and no single rate covers both.

Inc. profiles founders Allison Evans, Kelly Love and Marilee Nelson raising $1 million and rebranding as Branch Basics around a single cleaning solution; Brandiary reports the brand reached $40 million in revenue in 2023, and founder interviews note Target retail expansion — an established, scaled home brand.

name: Branch Basics

reasons.compensation: A published 10% flat rate on the brand's own Awin profile, with the ambassador track tiering up to 20% per the ambassador directory; no cap statement was found, so the cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Two public application routes (Awin and the ambassador program via the brand's site), but no published partnerships email was verified.
reasons.credibility: Scaled DTC brand with reported $40M 2023 revenue, national press (Inc.) and Target retail distribution.
reasons.niche_fit: Non-toxic cleaning concentrates and healthy-home products — a core home UGC niche ('clean with me', toxin-free home content).
reasons.opportunity_availability: Both programs are joinable now; the ambassador track is open to creators with as few as 1,000 followers who already use the product.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Two live creator routes: an open Awin affiliate program plus a dedicated Ambassador Program on Superfiliate with a defined monthly story deliverable and a 1,000-follower entry bar aimed at small creators.

description: BarkBox, by BARK, Inc. (NYSE: BARK), founded in December 2011 in New York by Matt Meeker, Henrik Werdelin and Carly Strife, is the leading monthly subscription for dogs: themed BarkBox boxes (2 toys, 2 treats, 1 chew) and Super Chewer boxes for tough chewers, plus BARK Bright Dental and BARK Food, serving over two million dogs monthly through subscriptions and retail.

evidence.summary: BARK's own affiliate programme page (opened directly) states the BarkBox & Super Chewer programme 'works with hundreds of marketing affiliates', pays a flat tiered monthly CPA — 1–100 subscriptions = $15, 101–200 = $17, 201+ = $19 per subscription, tiers resetting monthly — with BarkShop on a CPS revshare, and invites applications ('Not on Impact Radius?' section). Because pay is flat per subscription, commission_rate is null. CONFLICTS: the same page states a 30-day tracking cookie, while CJ Affiliate listings report a 7-day cookie and $18 per BarkBox / $20 per Super Chewer or Bright Dental signup plus 10% on BARK Food (Lasso: $20.80 per sale via CJ, $50 threshold) — network terms differ by route and are noted here.

BravoDM (checked Oct 2026, not affiliated with BARK) lists the BARK Affiliate and Creator Program at barkbox.com/affiliate via Impact, open to affiliates and creators who love dogs to promote BarkBox and Super Chewer, and gives BARK's Instagram as @barkbox. BARK's own giveaway rules give instagram.com/barkbox and facebook.com/barkbox, and its TikTok posts are under @barkbox.

Inc. reports BARK had about 500 dogs 'on payroll' as influencers, ~6 million social followers, and that influencers reach out constantly with content submissions; a later case study notes #barkbox has been mentioned over 4 million times on Instagram — direct evidence of HIGH creator saturation.

Wikipedia: BarkBox launched December 2011 by Carly Strife, Matt Meeker and Henrik Werdelin, HQ New York, a monthly subscription providing dog products, services and experiences; BARK serves over two million dogs monthly through BarkBox and Super Chewer subscriptions and retail.

name: BarkBox

opportunity.title: BarkBox & Super Chewer Affiliate Program (Impact / CJ)

reasons.compensation: Flat tiered CPA on the brand's own page ($15/$17/$19 per subscription by monthly volume); CJ listings differ ($18–$20 signups, 10% on BARK Food) and cookie terms conflict (30-day on brand page vs 7-day on CJ) — no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated barkbox.com/affiliate creator route via Impact, but no published partnerships email on fetched pages.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2011, publicly traded BARK, Inc. (NYSE: BARK), over two million dogs served monthly plus 40k+ retail stores.
reasons.niche_fit: The original dog unboxing subscription — toys, treats and themed boxes are peak pet UGC material.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via Impact/CJ today; the brand states it works with hundreds of affiliates and is open to almost all partner types.
reasons.ugc_evidence: ~500 influencer dogs on payroll per Inc., #barkbox mentioned 4M+ times on Instagram, and a named Affiliate and Creator Program via Impact.

description: Wellness-technology company founded in 2016 and based in Taunton, United Kingdom, selling a wearable vagus-nerve toning device that uses patented infrasonic resonance (low-frequency sound waves and soundscapes, placed on the sternum) with a companion app to reduce stress and improve sleep, featured in The Times, Psychology Today, Men's Journal and Women's Health.

evidence.summary: Sensate's official affiliate page states: '10% for you, 10% discount for your community' — affiliates earn 10% commission on products bought with their unique discount code, applications reviewed within seven days, paid around the 15th of each month by UK bank transfer or PayPal elsewhere. No cap on earnings is stated anywhere on the page, so commission_cap is unknown.

The same page publishes partners@getsensate.com as the partner liaison email and links direct sign-up at https://af.uppromote.com/getsensate/register (UpPromote), with marketing materials and a partner liaison provided on approval.

The page carries a named affiliate case study (holistic health coach Lauren Vaknine describing promoting Sensate on her podcast and to clients), showing real creator/affiliate promotion, but no creator-count evidence was found, so creator_saturation is unknown.

CB Insights describes Sensate as a wellness technology company founded in 2016, based in Taunton, United Kingdom, offering a wearable device using infrasonic waves and soundscapes for relaxation and sleep with a mobile app.

name: Sensate

reasons.compensation: A clean published 10% commission plus a 10% community discount on the brand's own page; no cap statement, so not top band.
reasons.contact_access: A published partner-liaison email (partners@getsensate.com) plus a direct sign-up link on the official page — top band.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2016, UK-based, with national press features named on its own page (The Times, Women's Health, Men's Journal).
reasons.niche_fit: A wearable stress/sleep tech device with an app — squarely technology, with strong wellness-creator crossover.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up today via UpPromote with review promised within seven days.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured affiliate program with discount codes, creative library and a published named-affiliate case study.

description: Smalls, founded in 2017 in New York by Matt Michaelson and Calvin Bohn, is the first cat-only direct-to-consumer fresh food brand: gently cooked, human-grade, protein-packed fresh and freeze-dried cat food, portioned to each cat's calorie needs and delivered by subscription, now also in retail — a deliberately cat-first brand in a dog-dominated pet market.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky lists Smalls on Impact at 35% commission per successful trial purchase, regions ALL. RATE CONFLICT: Lasso lists 24% per trial purchase with a 30-day cookie. The two published trial rates (35% vs 24%) do not agree and no brand-owned program page publishing a rate was fetched, so commission_rate is recorded as 35 from the Impact listing with the conflict stated here, and compensation is scored conservatively.

Skimlinks' pet affiliate roundup describes Smalls as a DTC fresh, gently cooked, human-grade cat food subscription, 'voted #1 healthiest cat food', with its affiliate program available in the United States — corroborating a live, joinable program.

Beacons Universe (updated 18 Nov 2026) counts 114 creators who have posted about Smalls all-time, 9 in the last 30 days and 7 sponsored posts in the last 12 months — active creator activity, insufficient evidence for 'low' saturation, so saturation is unknown.

Smalls' own Business Wire release: founded 2017 as the first cat-first brand, raised $19M (2023), had generated 8-figures in sales feeding more than 100,000 cats, entering retail; it directs readers to www.smalls.com and Instagram @smallsforcats. Inc. later reported Smalls reached $100M annual revenue.

name: Smalls

opportunity.title: Smalls Affiliate Program (Impact) — per trial purchase

reasons.compensation: Published trial-purchase rates are high (35% on Impact per LinkClicky) but conflict with Lasso's 24%, and no cap statement is published — scored down for the conflict.
reasons.contact_access: Joinable via the Impact listing only; no published partnerships email or brand-owned program page was fetched.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2017, $34M+ raised, 100,000+ cats fed, reported $100M annual revenue and new retail distribution.
reasons.niche_fit: Cat-only fresh food — an underserved, high-engagement corner of pet UGC dominated by dog brands.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program live and joinable in the US via Impact/Skimlinks today.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 114 Beacons creators with recent sponsored posts, plus paid social-series/podcast creator deals reported by Inc.

description: B Corp certified social enterprise founded in Melbourne, Australia in 2010, describing itself as the world's largest D2C toilet paper company, selling recycled and bamboo toilet paper, paper towels and tissues in playful packaging and donating 50% of profits to non-profits delivering clean water and sanitation; it raised $30.7 million in a 2021 Series A and was named to TIME's TIME100 Companies list in 2026.

evidence.summary: The brand's Awin (AU) programme publishes a full commission-group table with a 30-day cookie: the 'Influencer and Blogger' and 'Content' groups earn 12% CPA on new customers, while the Standard Rate is 2% on new customers and the return-customer (default) rate is 1% across groups. RATE STRUCTURE NOTE: the headline 12% applies only to influencer/content partners on new-customer sales; standard affiliates get 2%/1%.

A separate Awin (US) programme listing shows a much lower 2% default commission rate for new customers with a 30-day cookie — US creators should confirm which programme and commission group they are placed in before relying on the 12% AU influencer rate.
The brand's official US About page confirms the model: rolls made from recycled fibres or bamboo and 50% of profits donated toward ensuring everyone has access to clean water and a toilet.

Parsers VC lists Who Gives A Crap as Melbourne, Australia-based, founded 2010, with $30.7M raised, and reports its April 2026 naming to TIME's TIME100 Companies industry leaders in social good, with over $14 million in total donations announced.

name: Who Gives A Crap

opportunity.title: Who Gives A Crap Affiliate Programme — Influencer and Blogger Group (Awin)

reasons.compensation: 12% on new-customer sales for influencer/content groups is strong, but it drops to 1% on returning customers and the standard rate is only 2%, so blended earnings will run well below the headline.
reasons.contact_access: A public Awin application route with full published commission tables, but no published partnerships email was verified.
reasons.credibility: B Corp social enterprise operating since 2010, $30.7M Series A, TIME100 Companies recognition and 50%-of-profits donation model stated on its own site.
reasons.niche_fit: Everyday household paper essentials with a strong sustainability and humour angle — a proven fit for home and eco-living UGC.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The programme is live and joinable on Awin in both AU and US variants today.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Awin publishes a dedicated 'Influencer and Blogger' commission group distinct from standard affiliates — direct evidence the programme is structured for creators, not just coupon publishers.

description: MOFT (Mobile Office for Travelers), founded in 2017 and headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, makes origami-inspired, minimalist portable productivity accessories — invisible laptop stands, phone stands and wallets, tablet stands and MagSafe accessories — for smartphones, tablets and laptops, selling through its own store and distributors to over one million users.

evidence.summary: MOFT's official site publishes a dedicated 'Influencer Affiliate Program' page and a separate 'Affiliate Program' page (both confirmed live in search results from moft.com). HONEST LIMIT: the page body is JavaScript-rendered and returned empty on text fetch, so no rate, email or cap statement could be read from the official page itself — commission_cap is therefore unknown.

Lasso's MOFT listing gives the program as Tech category at 10% per sale and describes the standard join flow (application, approval in a few days, affiliate dashboard and referral link). This 10% is third-party reported only — it is NOT confirmed on a readable official page, hence commission_rate rests on this listing.

Brand Wiki describes MOFT as founded in 2017, established in Silicon Valley, California (engineering/manufacturing in Shenzhen), an acronym for Mobile Office for Travelers, with over one million users and distribution via its own store, Apple retail channels for select items and authorized distributors.

name: MOFT

reasons.compensation: 10% per sale per the Lasso listing; discounted because the rate could not be read on MOFT's own (JS-rendered) page and no cap terms are published.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated official program page with a join route, but no published partnerships email was verified — mid-range.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2017, million-plus users, Kickstarter-proven launches and Apple-channel distribution for select products.
reasons.niche_fit: Phone/laptop stands, wallets and desk-tech accessories are core everyday-tech UGC territory — desk-setup and travel-tech creators especially.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program page is live on moft.com today with an application route.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A program explicitly named and built for influencers on the brand's own site, not just a publisher network listing.

description: Consumer AR glasses company founded in 2017 in Beijing, China by Dr. Chi Xu (formerly Nreal), designing, developing and marketing lightweight AR/display eyewear — the XREAL Air and One series, Beam Pro companion and Project Aura Android XR glasses — that act as a large portable virtual screen for phones, PCs and consoles.

evidence.summary: XREAL's official Visionaries creator program page recruits 'Authentic Storytellers', 'XREAL Gurus' and 'Passionate Contributors' to create posts, videos and reviews; members must produce at least one piece of content per month, tag @XREAL_Global / #XREALVisionaries, and perks include product testing before launch, event invitations, exposure support and brand swag. The page names only nine current Visionaries (Katsuya, Kola, ketley2aug, eminus, justinseans, Getting Things Dun, Sensasian, JoyReignVR, UGEplex) — a deliberately small named cohort, supporting low creator saturation.

Under 'Potential Collaboration' the page states Visionaries 'may be invited to participate in our affiliate program, offering the opportunity to earn a commission on sales generated through your direct recommendations.' No commission rate is published anywhere fetched, so commission_rate is null and commission_cap is unknown. Joining is by application form on the page with manual review, approval and an NDA-backed agreement.
The page closes: 'To learn more about the program, including limits and availability, please email us at info@xreal.com' — a published program contact email on the official creator page.

Crunchbase lists Xreal (legal name XREAL, Inc., formerly Nreal) as founded in 2017 and based in Beijing, China, a developer of lightweight ready-to-wear mixed reality glasses; TechCrunch (May 2026) covers XREAL as Google's smart-glasses / Android XR partner for Project Aura.

name: XREAL

reasons.compensation: Affiliate commission exists only as a possible invitation for Visionaries and no rate is published anywhere fetched, so this stays very low per the rubric.
reasons.contact_access: A published program email (info@xreal.com) plus a full application form on the official page.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2017, a leading global consumer AR-glasses provider and Google's Android XR partner, with mainstream tech-press coverage.
reasons.niche_fit: Consumer AR glasses are peak technology UGC — unboxings, gaming/movie screen demos and XR reviews are the program's exact content ask.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open now, but entry is manual-review and agreement/NDA based, and the program is described as voluntary.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A named, structured creator/ambassador program with a public roster, monthly content duties, product-testing and content-amplification perks — the strongest UGC evidence in this group.

description: Vertically integrated US mattress and bedding manufacturer founded by brothers John and Rob Merwin in Phoenix, Arizona in 1995, which pioneered bed-in-a-box in 2008, makes its mattresses in its own Arizona factories at factory-direct prices, and since 2021 has sat within 3Z Brands alongside Helix Sleep.

evidence.summary: Brooklyn Bedding's official Ambassador Program page states verbatim: 'Earn a 5% commission on every Brooklyn Bedding Mattress sale made through your referral link', 'A unique URL will be provided for you, via Impact', and under the heading 'Uncapped Earnings': 'The more you share your link the more you earn! Enjoy uncapped commissions when people shop your link.' Sign-up is via Impact from the page.

The same page frames the programme for social sharing — step 3 is 'Share your referral link with friends, family, or social media followers' — an ambassador model aimed at creators and advocates rather than only media publishers.
The brand's own story page confirms it has been family-owned since 1995, launched bed-in-a-box in 2008, and designs and ships mattresses from its own state-of-the-art factory in Phoenix, Arizona.

name: Brooklyn Bedding

reasons.compensation: A published 5% on mattress sales with commissions explicitly stated as uncapped on the official page; the percentage itself is modest but order values are high.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated official programme page with a direct Impact sign-up route, but no published partnerships email.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 1995, a bed-in-a-box pioneer with its own US factories, now part of 3Z Brands with Helix Sleep.
reasons.niche_fit: Mattresses and bedding made in-house — a core home/sleep UGC category with big-ticket orders that make even a 5% rate meaningful per sale.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up today from the official page — join on Impact, receive a personalised link once approved.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A named Ambassador Program on the brand's own site, explicitly built around sharing referral links with social media followers.
